Both got me to the article and back fine. My preference comes down to not losing my place in the library. When I click into an article to read it, I usually want to come back and keep going down my list — so I'd rather the original open in a separate tab and leave my library sitting exactly where it was, rather than my library page being replaced and me having to find my way back to the same spot.

Whichever of these keeps my library open and undisturbed in the background is the one I want — that reads like Version B, where I pop over to the article and my library's still there waiting when I'm done. So Version B, as long as opening an article never makes me lose where I was in my list.
